clauses.name: Timid Brain
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as the Timid Brain is in hand, you can discard a Will from your hand: Play the Timid Brain in Support.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Only during Reaction and while Timid Brain remains in Hand, its controller may discard a distinct Will; the Immediate Effect then creates a normal responseable play of Timid Brain in Support and leaves no stale permission.

clauses.name: Ranba, Silent Abductor
clauses.printedParagraph: During the Reaction, as long as the last manifestation that entered in Support under the control of an opponent has a base power equal to or less than 2, you may reveal and discard Ranba from your hand. If you do and you are not the owner of that manifestation, put it into your Empathic Vessel.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Only during Reaction, when the latest opposing Support entry still has base power 2 or less, Ranba is revealed and discarded from Hand; on resolution that Support enters the controller's Vessel only if the controller does not own it.

clauses.name: Denegath, the Regulator
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Denegath is in the Interzone, during Reaction you may Exhaust it and pay 🔘🔘: The First Manifestation you control returns to its owner's hand, that Manifestation cannot be played until the end of the turn, then Chain from your hand.
clauses.expectedBehavior: Only during Reaction from the Interzone, a ready Denegath exhausts and pays two Hollow Essence; on resolution its controller's First Manifestation returns to its owner's Hand, is barred from play for the turn, and a different legal Hand Manifestation is chained.

limits: This proof certifies the three printed paragraphs, their exact Reaction windows, legal source or cost gates, atomic refusals and first authoritative transitions.
It does not re-certify every generic Stack response, movement replacement, Vessel capacity interaction or Chain outcome owned by other families.
